hero.subText: Type-First Build Compilation with Runtime Orchestration
hero.description: Pristine TypeScript types compiled into live runtime blueprints. Zero schema duplication, zero bundle inflation.

blockOne.description: Xalor is a build-time TypeScript engine that transforms native types into a live runtime system for validation, generation, and transformation — without duplicating schemas or shipping heavy validation libraries.

blockTwo.description: Unlike **Zod** or **Yup** which require writing heavy runtime schemas, or macro generators like **Typia** which clutter your git history with generated files, Xalor uses a silent background compiler watcher to turn pristine TypeScript interfaces into optimized runtime maps.
list: _The Result_ Use them natively at runtime.

one.description: Handle external API inputs cleanly with flexible runtime safety boundaries.

two.description: Generate type-safe mocks, staging state objects, or default templates out of thin air.

three.description: Manipulate object shapes inline at runtime using type properties as commands.

four.description: Eliminate the manual schema-updating workflow forever. When you modify your interface, your runtime behavior changes natively on the very next compilation step.

installation.description: Set up the core package using your preferred node dependency tool chain.
installation.footnote: Note: Because Xalor handles type extraction in the background, your environment needs to include our bundler transformer setup during your normal _pnpm build_ or _vite build_ process.
installation.codeBlock:
npm install @bgskinner2/xalor
pnpm add @bgskinner2/xalor
yarn add @bgskinner2/xalor

requirements.description: You must register the transformation plugin inside your _tsconfig.json_ file. For advanced environment configurations, see the Full Setup Guide.

list: Eliminates the _Dual-Source Tax_- Write your data definitions precisely once. Stop maintaining matching type interfaces and validation schemas concurrently.
Massive Client Bundle Reduction- Moves data model parsing completely to the build stage. Production apps inherit tiny metadata maps rather than thousands of lines of heavy validation parsing logic.
GPS Telemetry Traceability- When an object fails matching rules, Xalor flags the exact file path and line location of the target TypeScript source code instead of throwing unhelpful generic errors.

header.description: A high-performance type engine that reads your native TypeScript definitions to handle automatic, ultra-fast data validation at runtime—with zero code bloat, zero duplicate schemas, and zero background resource waste.

singleSourceOfTruth.description: Every other validation framework forces you into a `double-maintenance tax.` You have to manually write a custom runtime validation schema language blocks (like a Zod schema) and then write a mirrored TypeScript interface right next to it just to get autocompletion.
singleSourceOfTruth.subDescription: Xalor treats your standard, everyday TypeScript types as the absolute, single source of truth. You write a standard type, pass it to Xalor's proxy handle, and the engine takes over. If you modify or delete a type property, your workspace data layers adapt instantly with hard-zero duplication overhead.

phantomBuild.description: Legacy validation tools bloat your production application files by compiling into massive blocks of inline JavaScript variables and property trees that travel straight to your user's browsers.
phantomBuild.subDescription: Xalor completely erases your type structures from the final compiled build output. It strips away the clutter, leaving behind an exceptionally lean, bare-metal runtime execution footprint. Your production bundlers (Vite, Rollup) get 100% tree-shaking purity, and your private API structures are safely insulated from malicious reverse-engineering.

cacheStability.description: When multiple processes or code editors compile your code simultaneously, they introduce severe write contentions that can cause silent database file truncation, split-second file corruption, or lose your editor's autocomplete intellisense.
cacheStability.subDescription: Xalor guards your cache data using The Atomic Shield—an automated write barrier that flushes database snapshots into a temporary handle before executing a single native atomic rename operation to prevent split-second file truncation. Simultaneously, The Ghost Emitter dynamically injects updated string keys straight into your editor's autocomplete maps behind the scenes with absolute zero source folder pollution.

typeGraphTelemetry.description: Validation is just a side-effect. By extracting deep compile-time metadata, Xalor answers the ultimate question: 'What else can you do with types?' It unlocks an entire ecosystem of live code tracking, automatic mock simulations, and visual architecture analytics.
typeGraphTelemetry.subDescription: Launch our secure Cross-Origin UI (`npx xalor studio`) to view an interactive 3D map of your application's data models. Monitor schema evolution lineage, track validation health density metrics, and instantly generate full-fidelity mock data pools or automated clients straight from your static code definitions in real-time.

empiricalBenchmarks.description: We don't ask you to take our word for it. When evaluated down to execution velocity and bundle impact, Xalor strips away the performance penalties of traditional validation libraries to deliver true bare-metal efficiency.
empiricalBenchmarks.subDescription: By executing type unrolling entirely at compilation phase rather than evaluating properties dynamically at runtime, data processing checks bypass overhead completely. Contrast your project specs directly against industry baselines across bundle sizes and validation speeds to see the architectural performance deltas live.
